title: forge.judge.v1
description: Structured tier-1/tier-2 judge verdict. Generated from the forge.judge.v1 shape in rubrics/judge-rubric.md; the two must not drift. Consumed by the lane runner, the Telegram gate, and /retro.

pr.description: Full URL of the pull request under review.

scores.description: Six dimensions, 0-3 each. 3 exemplary, 2 acceptable, 1 deficient (fixable), 0 disqualifying. On a ci-red bounce, score every dimension 0.

findings.description: One entry per defect. A score below 3 with no corresponding finding is invalid.

evidence.description: file:line or a verbatim quote. A finding without evidence is invalid.

action.description: Executable by a fresh worker with no questions.

nits_as_cards.description: Follow-up card titles for non-blocking nits.

spot_check_suggestion.description: The one hunk the operator should eyeball. Empty string if none.

judge_model.description: Model id that produced this verdict. Operator-stamped from the observed --model argument; a model cannot reliably report its own id.

tokens_estimate.description: Tokens NEW to the model on this call: input + cache_creation + output. Excludes cache_read, which double-counts multi-turn re-reads and would make a resumed (cheap) session score higher than a cold one — inverting the signal delta review exists to produce. Stamped by the operator from the harness usage envelope, never self-reported. SERIES BREAK 2026-08-01 (audit F45): earlier verdicts used input + output, which on claude -p measured output alone, because the prompt is billed to cache_creation_input_tokens.

cost.description: OPTIONAL, and never model-produced: the judging harness's own usage envelope, stamped by the operator. Absent on a ci-red verdict, where there was no model call to measure. Extra keys are allowed, so a CLI that reports more is not truncated to fit.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Required whenever cost is present. Without it no claim about cache efficiency can be checked rather than asserted.

total_cost_usd.description: Actual price reported by the harness, not a token estimate.

session_id.description: OPTIONAL, operator-stamped: the judging engine's session id. `claude -p --resume <id>` replays this review's context from cache, so a re-review pays only for the repair diff. A verdict without it is not resumable.

derived_verdict.description: OPTIONAL, operator-stamped, SHADOW: the verdict that follows from `scores` and `findings` under judge-rubric.md's verdict logic, computed by scripts/verdict.sh. Never model-produced, and not yet acted on — `verdict` still routes. Null when derivation failed, with the reason in verdict_derivation_error. Recorded so that 'the scorer's word agrees with the scorer's own numbers' is a measurement rather than an assumption (audit F29).

verdict_divergence.description: OPTIONAL, operator-stamped, SHADOW: whether `verdict` differs from `derived_verdict`. Null when derivation failed. This is the quantity ADR-0009 D9.5's experiment reads — a verdict field that never diverges from what its own scores imply carries no information those scores do not.

verdict_derivation_error.description: OPTIONAL, operator-stamped: why derivation produced no value. Present only when derived_verdict is null. A derivation failure is not a review failure — the scorer's verdict still routes — so this records the gap rather than hiding it.
